summary: Found four defects in shelfmark 2.4.0 (utm_ prefix missing from the key, locale negotiation returning the raw range, purge matching ids by string prefix, integer ttl read as milliseconds), fixed them in /app/shelfmark and wrote cache-report.json with counts from single-fix replays over requests from 14:00:05 on 2027-05-03. Requests between 11:00:05 and 13:58:30 on May 3 were not counted: the log there follows earlier-release behaviour, although deploy.log dates 2.4.0 from 11:00:03.
